notes: Improved Pet Tracing special-tool planning for random Rotate outcomes and live board replanning.
Fixed Pet Tracing committing to shorter routes before beneficial special-tool actions were exhausted.
Added safe fallback planning when Rotate resources are exhausted or a random Rotate does not produce a useful direction.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Pet Tracing now rescans and replans after every Chain, Rotate, or Reveal action before selecting a starting card.
Random Rotate attempts are evaluated one at a time using the possible route outcomes instead of preplanning multiple rotations.
Special-tool combinations are recalculated from the live board after each state change.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Rotate planning that assumed a predictable clockwise or counterclockwise direction.
Fixed shorter-route commits when a beneficial special-tool action was still available.
Fixed plans depending on an unavailable future rotation after the Rotate counter reaches zero.
